title: 修复跨时区事件日期归桶
issue:
Synthetic development fixture, hand-authored for PatchForge; not an external benchmark.

Repair daily_counts(events, offset_minutes=0). events is a list of valid ISO-8601 timestamp strings that include UTC Z or an explicit UTC offset. Bucket each instant by calendar date in the requested fixed UTC offset, given as integer minutes in [-1439,1439]. Return a dictionary mapping YYYY-MM-DD to its count, inserted in ascending date order. Raise ValueError for naive timestamps or an out-of-range offset. An empty event list returns {}. Convert the represented instant to the target offset; do not merely relabel its timezone. The current implementation places events crossing midnight in the wrong day.
